note: Forced-flat floor per vanilla tree, from spec-grievances.md. Floor = minimum points that must buy a number on the way to the capstone, taking behavior greedily at every gate. A lower bound on filler, not a prediction of builds.
reputation: Specs with poor reputations average 22.7 forced-flat points; specs with good reputations average 14.4.

failureModes.name: Structurally boring
failureModes.text: The tree forces the climb to be spent on numbers. Retribution, Marksmanship, Feral, Demonology. The rework fixes this completely.

failureModes.name: Numerically weak
failureModes.text: The spec does not put out enough. Shadow priest sits at 11 forced flat, among the best figures in the game, and still has a poor reputation. The rework does nothing for this, and pretending otherwise is how a design document loses credibility.

failureModes.name: Valued for what you give other people
failureModes.text: Several specs hold raid slots for an aura or a totem. Logged output understates them, and a rebalance driven by personal numbers will overcorrect. A composition problem, not a talent problem.
